training.negatives: One teacher-nearest eligible training tool per query plus tools positive for other batch rows. Mask same-repository and normalized same-name ambiguous tools in both losses.

development.method: Family-macro and query-weighted metrics on the audited dev catalog. Same lexical weights for every dense scorer. Record provider-paired uncertainty and each seed.

final_evaluation: Development only. A candidate needs a separately frozen holdout and a measured same-runtime CPU trade-off before release.
